# Bambu printer

Show a Bambu Lab printer's status, temperatures, progress and remaining time, with Pause/Resume and Stop buttons.

## Required Home Assistant integration

This widget reads a printer through the **[Bambu Lab integration (`ha-bambulab`)](https://github.com/greghesp/ha-bambulab)** in Home Assistant. The panel only talks to Home Assistant; it has no direct connection to the printer. Setting up the integration is described by its own project.

## Configure in the editor

1. Open a page in the [web editor](../editor.md#layout-workspace) and add **Bambu printer**.
2. Use **Search** beside the entity field to choose an entity by name. Configure its options below.
3. Resize the widget for its content, then **Save** the layout. Try its controls on the panel.

Select the print status sensor, then the temperature, progress and remaining-time sensors. Pause, Resume and Stop buttons, the current step and the job name are optional. The example cards are 354 × 420 px; the minimum is 320 × 320 px.

## Entities and interaction

**Supported primary entities:** `sensor.*`

| Setting / behaviour | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Options | explicit entity bindings: nozzle and bed temperature, progress, remaining time, optional step and job name, optional pause, resume and stop buttons |
| Interaction | Pause or Resume (one button) and Stop (after a confirmation) press the bound Home Assistant buttons; Status opens a read-only detail popup |

## What the card shows

- **Header:** the card name (optional) and the print status: Printing, Paused, Finished, Failed, Offline and so on; the current step is shown below it when the card is tall enough.
- **Illustration:** a simple, original drawing of the printer. Nozzle and bed temperatures have a separate row below it, or a column beside it in wide cards. The nozzle and bed take a warm colour while they are hot.
- **Progress and remaining time** of a running or paused job, and a progress bar. A finished or failed job is marked **Last job**; an idle or offline printer shows no progress.
- **Buttons:** **Pause** (while printing) or **Resume** (while paused), **Status** and **Stop**.

A missing or unavailable reading shows a dash, never zero. The remaining time is shown in minutes, converted from the unit Home Assistant reports (minutes, hours or seconds).

## Steps

1. In the panel editor, add **Bambu printer**. The editor asks Home Assistant for your Bambu Lab printers; with a single printer it is chosen at once.
2. With several printers, choose yours in the **Printer** list (**Find printers** looks again). The print status, temperature, progress, remaining-time, step and job-name sensors and the Pause, Resume and Stop buttons are filled in.
3. Under **Entities** a single entity can still be changed or cleared. Without the buttons the card stays read-only.
4. Save the layout.

The entities are found through the integration's own entity registry, so it works in any Home Assistant language. They are saved with the layout; if you rename or re-create entities later, press **Find printers** and choose the printer again.

| Binding | Home Assistant entity | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Print status (primary) | the print status sensor | text |
| Nozzle temperature | nozzle temperature sensor | °C |
| Bed temperature | bed temperature sensor | °C |
| Progress | print progress sensor | % |
| Remaining time | remaining time sensor | minutes, hours or seconds, as Home Assistant reports it |
| Pause / Resume / Stop (optional) | the printer's pause, resume and stop buttons | button |
| Step and job name (optional) | current stage and job name sensors | text |
| Live camera (optional) | the printer camera entity, with MJPEG through Home Assistant | camera |

## Controls

- **Pause / Resume** shares one button and follows the printer's status. It is enabled only while Home Assistant is connected and the printer is printing or paused.
- **Stop** asks **Stop this print?** first; only the confirmation sends the command.
- **Status** opens a read-only popup with the job, status, step, both temperatures, progress and remaining time. It never sends a command.
- With **Live camera (optional, MJPEG)** configured under **Entities**, **Status → Live camera** opens the same live view as the Camera widget. Find printers fills the camera when the integration exposes one; the binding can be cleared. An A1 supplies low-rate images, so live view follows its camera rate. No direct printer access or additional credentials are needed.
- A command is sent once through Home Assistant and is not retried. The card then waits up to 15 seconds for the printer's status to change; if it does not, the card shows **Command not confirmed**.

<a href="../img/gallery/gallery_bambu_detail_glow.png"><img src="../img/gallery/gallery_bambu_detail_glow.png" alt="Status popup, glow" loading="lazy" width="720" height="720" style="width: 576px"></a>

The status popup is a simulator example (Glow style) with synthetic data.

Some firmware or access settings of the printer remove the command buttons from the integration; the panel cannot work around that and keeps those buttons disabled. The A1 is the initial target: other Bambu Lab models may work with the same bindings and show the same drawing, but have not been tested. Problems with the integration itself belong to its project.

## Layout limits

- Minimum: **320 × 320 px**.
- Maximum: **dashboard width × dashboard height**, capped by the selected display device's dashboard area.
- Leave space for the value, title and touch controls; the minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size.

The [display device overview](../choose-display.md) lists usable dashboard geometry. [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains title/content spacing and touch targets.
